name: Gym Star Simulator
creator: Gym Simulator Club
redeem: Launch Gym Star Simulator on Roblox and wait to load into the gym.
Click the Shop button on the left side of the screen.
Select the Code tab at the top of the Shop menu.
Type or paste the code into the text box and press Redeem.
notes:
Gym Star Simulator is a bodybuilding simulator from the Gym Simulator Club group, first released on Roblox in August 2024. You lift weights and work out to build muscle and stamina, hire trainers to boost your gains, hatch and upgrade pets, and unlock themed gyms with stronger equipment. Bodybuilding competitions and global leaderboards give you something to aim for.

The game runs in seasons, and the current one is Space Force. Codes commonly give Gym Tokens, wheel spins, Enchant Crystals for upgrading belts and other gear, or consumables such as protein bars and energy drinks. New codes tend to arrive with seasons, holidays and visit milestones, and the developers share them in the game description and in their Discord.

faq.q: Where is the code box in Gym Star Simulator?
faq.a: It is inside the Shop. Click the Shop button on the left side of the screen, select the Code tab at the top of the Shop menu, then type the code and press Redeem.

faq.q: What are Enchant Crystals used for in Gym Star Simulator?
faq.a: Enchant Crystals are used to upgrade belts and other gear. They are one of the common code rewards, alongside Gym Tokens, wheel spins and consumables like protein bars and energy drinks.

faq.q: Where does the Gym Star Simulator developer post new codes?
faq.a: Gym Simulator Club shares codes in the game description on Roblox and in their Discord. The current code, SPACEFORCE, is listed in the description alongside the Space Force season update, and new codes tend to arrive with seasons, holidays and visit milestones.

tips: Each new gym has stronger equipment, so unlocking the next gym is one of the biggest jumps in progress you can make. Work toward it instead of staying on early weights.
Trainers boost how much you gain from every workout. Getting one early means every lift after that counts for more.
Hatch pets and focus on upgrading your best ones. A few strong, upgraded pets help your gains more than a big team of weak ones.
Rebirths were added in a recent update. Check what bonus a rebirth gives before you use one, and save it for when your progress starts to slow down.
useRewards: SPACEFORCE gives 1,250 Gym Tokens and belongs to the Space Force season, so redeem it while that season is still running. Season codes like this are often swapped out when a new season starts. If a later code gives protein bars or energy drinks, use them when you are about to train for a long stretch, not right before you leave the game. Enchant Crystals from codes are best kept for the belt or gear you use most.
